questions.text: Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Colas and/or Quarry Products Harlaxton.

Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Colas and Quarry Products Harlaxton are close competitors in the supply of aggregates, road base and oversize products and there are not many alternatives, or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.

If you are a customer of Colas and/or Quarry Products Harlaxton for aggregates, road base or oversize products and were to stop sourcing from either or both, is it possible to switch your entire requirement to an alternative supplier? Please explain any costs (including transport costs), time delays, or technical barriers associated with making such a switch.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
